Indians want to retire by 50. Their bank balance says not so fastThe dream of retiring early is catching on, but there is a gap between wanting financial freedom and having enough money to achieve it.

Govt to monitor UPI MDR rollout, ensure merchants do not pass charges to consumersThe government will closely monitor the implementation of UPI MDR and work with payment aggregators to plug enforcement gaps and ensure merchants do not pass the additional cost on to consumers, government sources said, adding that the move is unlikely to trigger a significant rise in cash transactions or a decline in UPI usage.

Amazon, Walmart AI bots accused of favouring foreign goods, US senators seek probeTwo US senators have urged the FTC to investigate Amazon and Walmart over claims their AI shopping tools suppress Made in USA products and miss false labels. Listing will destroy its character: Noel Tata opposes Tata Sons IPO amid board pushTata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata has opposed any move to list Tata Sons and called for all possible alternatives to be explored first.

Tata Sons backs Chandrasekaran's reappointment, listing plan; Trusts may challengeThe Tata Sons board has backed N Chandrasekaran for another five-year term and begun steps towards listing the holding company. Sensex, Nifty end flat as Tata stocks rallyThe BSE Sensex opened at 74,182.62 and closed at 74,314.59, down 21.86 points or 0.03%. The Nifty 50 opened at 23,195.25 and ended at 23,270.60, gaining 53 points or 0.23%.

Noel Tata opposes N Chandrasekaran's reappointment, calls vote illegalThe Tata Sons board has approved N Chandrasekaran's continuation as chairman, but Noel Tata has opposed the move and termed the vote "illegal."

You can't 25bp a chokepoint: Iran mocks US Fed rate hike with equation linked to HormuzIranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf mocked the Federal Reserve's 25-basis-point rate hike with a satirical Hormuz-linked equation on X. entertainment.headline: Pregnant Deepika Padukone joins Ranveer as family seeks blessings at Siddhivinayak A day after visiting Lalbaugcha Raja, Ranveer Singh accompanied Deepika Padukone to Siddhivinayak Temple with his parents. The visit comes as the couple await their second child after sharing maternity photographs and family pictures.

Hindi films aren't called pan-India, why only South? Nani questions double standards At a Chennai press meet for The Paradise, actor Nani questioned why only South films are labelled pan-India. He said Hindi hits such as Jawan and Pathaan remain Hindi films, exposing what he sees as a double standard.

Let Chumbak be your comfort watch as the Khichdi-Sarabhai formula gets a new address Netflix's Chumbak follows families in a Chembur colony whose lives constantly overlap. The series updates the old-school comfort sitcom with neighbourhood chaos and character-led humour.

Marathi film Gondhal beats Dhurandhar, Hanuman Ansh to become India's Oscars entry Marathi film Gondhal has been selected as India's official entry for the 99th Academy Awards. It was chosen from more than 30 contenders in the Oscar race, including Main Vaapas Aaunga and Dhurandhar 2. It's a psychological and cultural thriller centred around a trapped young bride who turns her lover's obsession with a sacred folk ritual into a dangerous game of deception, desire and power.

Dupahiya Season 2 gets release date: Nirahua joins Gajraj Rao, Bhuvan Arora Prime Video has set the premiere date of Dupahiya Season 2 and added Nirahua to the cast. The new chapter returns to Dhadakpur with fresh complications, bigger stakes and the show's familiar humour.

In an exclusive interview, he said that doubt has also kept him adapting stories, technology and genres across decades.

Dev Sharma, now Ram in Ramayan Katha, was rejected as Lakshman in Ranbir's Ramayana Actor Dev Sharma said he lost Lakshman roles in Adipurush and Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana because of his height. He said the setbacks left him disheartened before he was cast as Lord Ram in Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha.

Vibe X review: 'Organic comedy' wins viewers, Kunal Kemmu gets praise Vibe has opened to largely positive reactions on X, with viewers praising its humour and cast. The first wave of posts has also split over whether Kunal Kemmu's directorial is best watched in theatres or on OTT.

Salman scolds driver after car accidentally runs over fan's foot amid chaos. Watch Actor Salman Khan pulled up his driver after a fan's foot came under his car outside a Ganpati celebration in Mumbai. The video quickly drew attention, alongside his visible concern for fans amid the crowd.

Salman Khan stops to comfort young fan after push at Ganpati event. Watch Salman Khan objected when a young fan was pushed at a Ganpati celebration. The Bollywood superstar then stopped to speak to him before leaving the gathering.

Haiwaan actor says friends skipped film, Hanuman Ansh director offers support Actor Mohit Raj posted an emotional video saying none of his friends had watched Haiwaan even four days after release. His remarks highlighted how deeply the film matters to him after a decade-long struggle in the industry.

sports.headline: Know your athlete: Tendenthoi Devi Haobijam's rowing journey to Nagoya Asian Games 2026: Tendenthoi Devi Haobijam is returning to the Asian Games in India's women's four with renewed confidence. Rizwan and fellow batter Imam-ul-Haq previously appeared before the agency, where they were questioned regarding travel, financial history, and personal details. Rizwan challenged the basis of the probe and questioned the agency's jurisdiction, seeking a halt to proceedings. The controversy unfolds alongside a Pakistan Cricket Board disciplinary inquiry after seven players were sent home following defeats in the opening Test matches in England.

Manu Bhaker, Tajinderpal Singh Toor named India flag-bearers Asian Games 2026: Two-time Olympic medallist Manu Bhaker and two-time Asian Games champion Tajinderpal Singh Toor will lead India at the Aichi-Nagoya opening ceremony.
